title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A story of wealth, love, and the American Dream in the roaring 1920s — a dazzling portrait of Jay Gatsby and the elusive Daisy Buchanan.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A powerful story about racial injustice and moral growth, told through the eyes of young Scout Finch in the American South.

author: George Orwell
description: A chilling vision of a totalitarian future society ruled by Big Brother, surveillance, and rewritten history.

title: Harry Potter
author: J.K. Rowling
description: The boy who lived begins his journey at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, uncovering secrets and dark plots.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins is swept into an epic quest to reclaim the lost treasure of the dragon Smaug — the prelude to The Lord of the Rings.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A sparkling comedy of manners in which Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy learn that first impressions are not always right.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: Holden Caulfield's unforgettable voice captures teenage alienation and the painful search for authenticity.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, a young nobleman becomes the leader of a rebellion that will change the galaxy forever.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A shepherd boy's journey in search of treasure becomes a timeless fable about following your personal legend.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: A murder in the Louvre uncovers a trail of hidden symbols and a secret that could shake the foundations of history.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A woman shoots her husband and never speaks again. A psychotherapist is obsessed with uncovering her secret.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny, repeatable changes.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: Stranded on Mars, astronaut Mark Watney must science his way out — alone, with only his wits and a potato farm.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: From the Big Bang to black holes — Hawking's landmark tour of the universe for the everyday reader.
